__request_topic__.text: 러브크래프트 공포 | 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

__baseline_prompt__.text: Photographic cosmic horror at the limits of human knowledge. The frame records an unknown presence; its discovery defeats ordinary understanding. On a refrigerated marine-biology workbench, a squat quartz observation cell fills the left two thirds of the photograph. Inside it, a wet, pale slate-colored tissue ribbon lies threaded through a square measuring lattice. The near part is thin enough to pin under a small steel clip, with a sharp contact shadow on the grid. Follow that same unbroken surface behind the lattice: it opens into a succession of enormous ribbed folds, each receding farther into a dense black interior, as if the small sample has become a cavern that the chamber cannot contain. The repeated fine pores and a single dark longitudinal vein continue from the clipped foreground edge into those distant vaults, making this visibly one continuous material. The last two grid bars bend away into that depth while the front bars remain straight. At frame right, the reference-guided person is working as a researcher, shown from the chest upward in three-quarter profile. Use the supplied portrait only as face-and-hair appearance guidance for the researcher. Her face has a soft oval contour, large dark brown eyes, a small straight nose and natural pink lips; her hair is a chin-length black bob with wispy separated bangs. She wears a plain pale work coat. Her right elbow stays close to her ribs, the gloved right hand holding a withdrawn sampling probe horizontally above its metal cradle. Her head has turned toward the sample and her parted lips and fixed gaze show the pause before she can complete that ordinary movement. A closed notebook under her resting left forearm provides an everyday counterweight to the impossible depth. Photograph this as a physically present laboratory discovery with moist surfaces, scratched steel and faint condensation. The camera is at workbench height on a shallow diagonal, using a natural 50mm perspective; keep the clipped tissue, the receding folds and the person's face legible together. A cold inspection lamp grazes the tissue from the left, while soft overhead fluorescence holds the facial detail. Restrained gray-green color and quiet exposure let the small containment frame and the immense interior carry the dread.
